en.headline: ICAC appoints Choi Shu-keung as Deputy Commissioner from next Tuesday
en.dek: Commissioner Woo Ying-ming announced that the current Director of Investigation (Government Sector) will also head the Operations Department, succeeding Ricky Yau who begins pre-retirement leave.
body: ICAC Commissioner Woo Ying-ming announced on Friday that Choi Shu-keung, currently Director of Investigation (Government Sector) of the Operations Department, has been appointed Deputy Commissioner of the ICAC with effect from 17 November.

Choi will also serve as Head of Operations, succeeding Ricky Yau Shu-chun, who will proceed on pre-retirement leave the same day. Woo said Choi has served at the ICAC for 28 years and brings extensive experience in anti-corruption work across the public and private sectors.
Choi, aged 54, joined the ICAC in 1998 as an investigation officer. He was promoted to Assistant Director of Operations in 2012 and has been Director of Operations since 2022.

Woo expressed confidence that Choi will maintain a professional standard in the Operations Department and continue effective anti-corruption work. He also thanked Yau for more than 30 years of service.

zh.headline: 廉署委任蔡樹強為副廉政專員 下周二起生效
zh.dek: 廉政專員胡英明宣布，現任執行處（政府部門）處長蔡樹強將同時出任執行處首長，接替同日展開退休前休假的丘樹春。
body: 廉政專員胡英明周五宣布，現任執行處（政府部門）處長蔡樹強獲委任為副廉政專員，由11月17日起生效。
蔡樹強將同時出任執行處首長，接替同日展開退休前休假的丘樹春。胡英明表示，蔡樹強投身廉署28年，在公私營領域反貪工作累積豐富經驗。
現年54歲的蔡樹強於1998年加入廉署任調查主任，2012年晉升為執行處助理處長，並自2022年起出任執行處處長。
胡英明深信蔡樹強能帶領執行處維持高度專業水平，繼續有效打擊貪污。他同時感謝丘樹春逾30年的貢獻。
